lines.en: label mollycamp1:
You know...there’s really nothing about today that makes much sense when you look at how I’ve approached my relationship with Ami as a whole.
lines.zh: 你知道吗……只要回头看看我和 Ami 整段关系的处理方式，今天发生的一切其实完全说不通。

lines.en: I mean, sure. We’ve gone on a number of trips together. And we’ve made more memories along the way than I ever would have assumed I’d make when I first opened my eyes and saw her standing there in the sunlight.
lines.zh: 当然，我们确实一起出过好几次门。而这一路上攒下的回忆，比我当初睁开眼、看见她站在阳光里那一刻所能想象的还要多。

lines.en: I had no idea who she was. And hearing that from me directly was probably startling despite how easily she played it off as some sort of memory lapse.
lines.zh: 我当时根本不知道她是谁。而这句话从我嘴里直接说出来，大概挺吓人的——尽管她轻描淡写地把它当成某种记忆断片糊弄过去了。

lines.en: I wonder just how many times she’s had to do such a thing — or how many times she’s had to kick herself into a shape that believes all that really {i}was{/i} just some sort of post-nap daze.
lines.zh: 我不知道她究竟做过多少次这样的事——又有多少次，她得把自己踢打成某种形状，好让自己相信那真的只{i}是{/i}睡醒后的恍惚。

lines.en: The point is, though...if today is meant to be a day of new beginnings, it should be a day where the {i}me{/i} I left at home would be unable to predict the actions of the me that’s in the woods.
lines.zh: 可重点是……如果今天注定是新的开始，那它就该是这样一天：被我留在家里那个{i}我{/i}，无法预测此刻在林子里这个我会做出什么。

lines.en: And since everything else has gone completely against my character so far, there’s only one person I can think of talking to right now if I want to keep that pattern up.
lines.zh: 而既然到目前为止一切都彻底违背了我的本性，那如果我想把这种模式继续下去，现在能想到的说话对象就只有一个人。

lines.en: scene black
So I tap on her name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 于是我在手机上点开她的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline1
: Hello?
: {i}Hey. What’s up?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿。怎么了？{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline2
: Sir?!
lines.zh: : 先生？！

lines.en: : {i}That’s right. {/i}
: I know it’s right! I just don’t know {i}why{/i} it’s right. Mayhap you’ve called the wrong number?
lines.zh: : 我知道没错！我只是不知道{i}为什么{/i}没错。莫非您是打错号码了？

lines.en: : Or better yet! You’ve been stricken with a deadly ailment and are now saying goodbye to everyone you know in the order of least to most appreciated!
lines.zh: : 或者，更妙的可能是——您染上了绝症，现在正按「最不受重视到最受重视」的顺序，跟所有认识的人一一道别！

lines.en: : {i}Right again. And you just happen to be the last person on that list.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}又说对了。而你正好是那张名单上的最后一个人。{/i}

lines.en: : Roll for deception.
lines.zh: : 进行欺骗检定。

lines.en: : {i}One million.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一百万。{/i}

lines.en: : All I heard was “one.” Which means you’ve critically failed as I already know you’ve yet to speak with the Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 我只听见「一」。也就是说您大失败了——因为我已经知道您还没跟剑道公主说过话。

lines.en: : {i}Tsuneyo’s with you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Tsuneyo 跟你在一起？{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline3
: Aye. We’re at the arcade. Would you like me to pass on a greeting?
lines.zh: : 是。我们在街机厅。要我替您问个好吗？

lines.en: : Who is that?
lines.zh: : 那是谁？

lines.en: : It is the Supreme Overlord. He’s dialed my number on accident. Would {i}you{/i} like me to pass on a greeting?
lines.zh: : 是至高霸主。他不小心拨了我的号码。要我替{i}您{/i}问个好吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不用。

lines.en: : Do the two of you even like one another?
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底喜不喜欢对方啊？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 算不上。

lines.en: : {i}She’s fine.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她还好。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline4
: Sir, apologies for repeating the transmission, but {i}why{/i} are you calling me exactly? I was under the impression you were still under the effects of corrupted blood.
lines.zh: : 先生，抱歉重复传送，不过您到底{i}为什么{/i}打给我？我印象里您还处在「腐败之血」的影响之下。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline5
: Is that another video game reference?
lines.zh: : 这又是一个游戏梗吗？

lines.en: : {i}Only to the deadliest plague in MMO history! No one was safe, Sir! The entire world needed to be reset and repaired before it went away!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那可是 MMO 史上最致命的一场瘟疫！没人能幸免，先生！整个世界都得重置修复一遍，它才消失！{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah well, that’s definitely a realistic way of fixing things. So hey, maybe I just need to wait for that to happen in order to feel normal again?
lines.zh: : 嗯，那确实是修东西的现实做法。那么，也许我只要等上那么一回，就能重新感觉正常了？

lines.en: : {i}Tuesday is just around the corner, Sir. Bug fixes should be rolling out.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}周二就在眼前了，先生。修复补丁应该快推出了。{/i}

lines.en: : Then it seems I have something to look forward to.
lines.zh: : 那看来我还有点盼头。

lines.en: : {i}Sir-{/i}
: I just wanted to hear your voice.
lines.zh: : 我只是想听听你的声音。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline6
: You...

: You {i}what?{/i} Apologies again, Sir. I believe my delusions of grandeur may have finally begun rewriting reality in a way that causes me to overwrite actual dialogue with what you’d say as a character in a dating sim.
lines.zh: : 您{i}什么{/i}？再次抱歉，先生。我想我的自大妄想终于开始改写现实了——它让我把真实的对话，覆盖成了您在恋爱模拟游戏里作为角色会说的话。

lines.en: : {i}I said I wanted to hear your voice.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我说了，我想听听你的声音。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline7
: Gods help me. What if this is permanent?
lines.zh: : 神明保佑。要是这是永久性的可怎么办？

lines.en: : Your face has changed colors, Emerald Guardian. And I know you well enough to understand that you must either be aroused or embarrassed if this is the case. Which one is it?
lines.zh: : 您的脸色变了，翡翠守护者。而我足够了解您，知道出现这种情况，您必定是兴奋了，或者害羞了。是哪一种？

lines.en: : Both I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得两者都有。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline5
: I just figured talking to you might be a nice change of pace since this admittedly isn’t a thing I do all that often.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，跟你聊聊天或许是个不错的调剂——毕竟说实话，这种事我平时并不常做。

lines.en: : {i}I’ll say, Sir. It’s been so long that I was taken quite aback when I saw Arthas Menethil’s name pop up on my screen just now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这我同意，先生。实在太久没见了，方才屏幕上跳出 Arthas Menethil 这个名字时，我着实吓了一跳。{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t know how to tell you this, but that is not my name and I’m not sure where you heard that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么跟你说，但那不是我的名字，我也不知道你从哪儿听来的。

lines.en: : {i}The name matters not, Sir. It’s just how you’re labeled in my phone. But what is all of this about a change of pace? Have things truly gotten so terrible that you’re looking to me of all people for help?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}名字不重要，先生。那只是您在我手机里的备注。不过调剂什么的到底是怎么回事？事情真的糟到您要找我这样的人帮忙了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : I guess so. But today isn’t really that bad, all things considered. In fact, it’s actually been pretty {i}good{/i} so far. Just...different.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过综合来看，今天其实没那么糟。事实上，到目前为止还挺{i}不错{/i}的。只是……不一样。

lines.en: : If you’re hanging out with Tsuneyo though, I can just call back some other time.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是正跟 Tsuneyo 在一起，我可以改天再打。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline8
: She actually just left!
lines.zh: : 她刚刚正好走了！

lines.en: : Who left?
lines.zh: : 谁走了？

lines.en: : {i}I can hear her.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我能听见她。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline9
: Geh!
: Oh. It appears a telepathic communication is coming in.
lines.zh: : 哦。看来有一段心灵感应通讯正在接入。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline10
: I must listen closely so the sounds are not muddled by various action games.
lines.zh: : 我必须仔细听，免得声音被各种动作游戏搅浑。

lines.en: : {i}Is everything-{/i}
: One moment...Sir! Channelling...my energy!
lines.zh: : 稍等……先生！正在……凝聚我的能量！

lines.en: : Message received. Rail everyone.
lines.zh: : 讯息已收到。把所有人统统干一遍。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline11
: Wow, {i}that{/i} worked too.
lines.zh: : 哇，{i}那{/i}也奏效了。

lines.en: : {i}What worked? What’s going on?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么奏效了？发生什么了？{/i}

lines.en: : Not much, Sir. Just, between this and the recent Dorm Wars, I’m beginning to think that some of my quirks aren’t actually fake after all.
lines.zh: : 没什么，先生。只是，这件事再加上最近那场宿舍战争，我开始觉得自己的一些怪癖说不定根本不是装的。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline5
: So we can keep talking?
lines.zh: : 那我们可以继续聊？

lines.en: : {i}We can talk for as long as you like! I’m still just confused as to why!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您想聊多久都行！我只是还是不明白为什么！{/i}

lines.en: : Like I said, I just wanted to try something different. And there’s no greater change of pace than going from talking to Ami then talking to the Emerald Molly of the MacCormack Jungle or whatever it was.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我只是想试试不一样的东西。而要说调剂，没有什么比「刚跟 Ami 说完话，接着又跟 MacCormack 丛林的翡翠 Molly 说话」更大的了——管它叫什么来着。

lines.en: : {i}That was so far off that I can’t help but feel somewhat offended, Sir. But still, is that alone enough to warrant seeking me out? I’ve proven on several occasions now that there’s nothing I can do to help you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您差得也太远了，我不禁有点受伤，先生。不过话说回来，光是这一点就足以让您来找我了？我已经证明过好几次，我什么都帮不了您。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Which depresses me greatly as I would very much LIKE to help you. I’m just not sure if a phone call alone will be enough to do that. But, then again, nor would meeting in person...so...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这让我非常沮丧，因为我实在很想帮您。我只是不确定，光靠一通电话够不够。但话说回来，当面见也没用……所以……{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not asking you to specifically do something that will help, Molly. I’m just asking you to exist. And to continue existing for at least the duration of this call.
lines.zh: : 我并没有要求你特地做什么对我有帮助的事，Molly。我只要求你存在着。至少在这通电话结束之前，继续存在着。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline12
: I have no plans to stop existing, Sir. And I’m happy to hear your voice as well.
lines.zh: : 我没打算停止存在，先生。我也很高兴能听到您的声音。

lines.en: : I’ve actually been thinking about you a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 其实我最近经常想起您。

lines.en: : {i}In what way?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}以什么方式？{/i}

lines.en: : Mostly just wondering when I’ll be able to see you again. The dorms have gotten rather lonely in the wake of your departure, Sir. The halls still call your name just as they did in days past.
lines.zh: : 主要是在想，什么时候还能再见到您。您离开之后，宿舍变得相当冷清，先生。走廊还在呼唤着您的名字，就像从前那些日子一样。

lines.en: : {i}Again, hate to be the bearer of bad news, but that probably wasn’t the hall you heard calling my name.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}又要说抱歉了，但我大概得泼盆冷水——您听见喊我名字的，恐怕不是走廊。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline13
: And I’m sure it’s not the hall I’ve been hearing call it recently either but rather someone else struggling with your absence, Sir.
lines.zh: : 而最近我听见喊它的，肯定也不是走廊，而是某个同样因为您不在而难受的人，先生。

lines.en: : {i}Well, it’s good to see that not much has changed on that end I guess.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，看来那一边倒是没什么变化，挺好的。{/i}

lines.en: : Good for you, perhaps. But all of us can’t stop wondering when we’ll be able to see you again. Your company may as well require a lottery ticket at this point in time, Sir.
lines.zh: : 也许对您来说是好事。可我们所有人都在忍不住想，什么时候才能再见到您。到这会儿，想跟您待一会儿简直得先中张彩票才行，先生。

lines.en: : {i}Then you can view this call as me trying to combat that to some extent.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你可以把这通电话，当成我在某种程度上对抗那件事的努力。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline14
: {i}I know that things have to change. And I know that there are certain things I’m going to have to do if Ami is ever going to regain some normalcy in her life.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我知道事情必须改变。我也知道，如果 Ami 想让生活重新回到某种正常，我就必须做一些事。{/i}

lines.en: : But what about you, Sir?
lines.zh: : 可您呢，先生？

lines.en: : {i}What do you mean?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你什么意思？{/i}

lines.en: : What about {i}you{/i} regaining some sort of normalcy in your life? Because your prior proposal made it sound more like you’re just doing this for Arborea’s sake.
lines.zh: : {i}您{/i}自己重新找回某种正常的生活呢？因为您方才那番话听起来，更像是您只是为了 Arborea 才这么做的。

lines.en: : {i}Oh. Well, that’s because I am.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦。嗯，因为事实就是如此。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline15
: {i}Then that’s not good at all, Sir! And this is coming from someone who quite literally has devoted herself to a variety of fictional characters!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那可一点都不好，先生！说这话的人，可是真的把自己献给了好几个虚构角色呢！{/i}

lines.en: : Then you should understand better than most what it means to live for someone else and not yourself. Just, in my case, it’s a living human. And in yours, it’s probably a werewolf or something.
lines.zh: : 那你该比大多数人都更懂，为别人而不是为自己而活是什么感觉。只不过在我这儿，那是个活人。而在你那儿，大概是匹狼人之类的。

lines.en: : {i}I believe you may have me confused with Noriko, Sir. Which would actually explain this call quite well if you had not already addressed me by name.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想您可能把我和 Noriko 搞混了，先生。如果您方才没有直呼我的名字，这通电话倒还真是能被解释得通。{/i}

lines.en: : Is Noriko also into werewolves?
lines.zh: : Noriko 也喜欢狼人？

lines.en: : {i}The word “also” implies that I am into them as well, Sir.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您用「也」这个字，是在暗示我也喜欢，先生。{/i}

lines.en: : Are you not?
lines.zh: : 你不是吗？

lines.en: : {i}No comment.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}无可奉告。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s what I thought.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我就知道。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline16
: All yiff aside, Sir- there’s something I’m rather curious about.
lines.zh: : 撇开兽控那套不谈，先生——有件事我相当好奇。

lines.en: : {i}Probably not the best time to ask about whether or not I’m still up for sexual experimentation with you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}现在大概不是问您还愿不愿意跟我做性实验的好时机。{/i}

lines.en: if makotonodowin == True:
: Oh, don’t worry. I’ve done enough of that in recent days and don’t mind another period of waiting before something else enters my body.
lines.zh: : 哦，别担心。最近几天我已经做得够多了，在别的东西进入我身体之前，再等一阵子我也不介意。

lines.en: : {i}Wow. What the hell have you been getting up to while I’ve been away?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哇。我不在的这些日子，你到底在搞什么名堂？{/i}

lines.en: : Losing the last shred of my dignity, Sir.
lines.zh: : 在丢掉我最后一丝尊严，先生。

lines.en: else:
: That is not what I had in mind, but I will make a mental note of this so I do not accidentally disgust you again.
lines.zh: : 我想听的不是这个，不过我会在心里记一笔，免得又不小心让您倒胃口。

lines.en: : Regardless, the thing I’m curious about is exactly what you’re {i}up{/i} to at the moment as you’ve alluded to the day being rather different and I’m not quite sure what that means.
lines.zh: : 总之，我好奇的是您此刻到底在{i}干什么{/i}——您提到今天相当不一样，而我不太确定那是什么意思。

lines.en: : Have you and Arborea departed the inn on a fetch quest? Is your party larger than just the two of you? What’s going on precisely?
lines.zh: : 您和 Arborea 是不是离开旅店去做跑腿任务了？您的队伍只有你们两个吗？具体是什么情况？

lines.en: : {i}I’m camping.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在露营。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline17
: {i}Camping?{/i} Like...outside?
lines.zh: : {i}露营{/i}？就是……在户外？

lines.en: : {i}Weird, right?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}挺怪的，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: : But...outside is where the sun is, Sir. You don’t mean to tell me you’re willingly spending time under such an evil entity, do you?
lines.zh: : 可……户外是太阳的领地啊，先生。您该不是想告诉我，您居然心甘情愿地待在这样一个邪恶存在底下吧？

lines.en: : {i}There are a few trees blocking it out, but yeah. This is where the sun is.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有几棵树挡着，不过没错。太阳就在那儿。{/i}

lines.en: : Should I send help? I can have a gryphon headed your way in no time at all, Sir. Just do not be alarmed if that gryphon is disguised as a taxi.
lines.zh: : 要我叫人去救您吗？我马上就能派一只狮鹫过去，先生。只是那只狮鹫可能伪装成出租车，请您别惊慌。

lines.en: : {i}It’s fine, Molly. And yes, this is definitely something I’d never come up with on my own. But I needed to get Ami out of the house somehow and I figured she’d enjoy something like this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没事的，Molly。而且没错，这绝对是我自己想不出来的主意。但我总得想办法把 Ami 带出家门，我想她会喜欢这种事的。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline18
: But then why are you talking to {i}me?{/i} You should be with her if you’re really doing this to try and make her happy, Sir.
lines.zh: : 那您为什么在跟{i}我{/i}说话？如果您真是为了让她开心才做这些，那您该陪着她才对，先生。

lines.en: : {i}I can’t. She’s been kidnapped.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不行。她被绑架了。{/i}

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, what percentage of this conversation has been entirely fabricated so far?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇问一下，到目前为止，这场对话有多少比例是您完全编出来的？

lines.en: : Because I’m starting to think it’s all of it and that you really did somehow roll a one million on that deception check earlier.
lines.zh: : 因为我开始觉得是全部——而且您方才那次欺骗检定，可能真的掷出了一百万。

lines.en: : {i}Everything has been real, Molly.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一切都是真的，Molly。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ami’s with a friend of mine right now. And I’m fine with it because she’s another girl that’s my age and Ami really needs a mother figure right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Ami 现在和我一个朋友在一起。我并不介意，因为她也是个跟我年纪相仿的女孩，而 Ami 现在真的很需要一个母亲般的人。{/i}

lines.en: : I think a parent as a whole would be fine, Sir. It doesn’t have to be a mother.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有个家长就够了，先生。不一定要是母亲。

lines.en: : {i}I think for her it does. But you might be right. I don’t know.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得对她来说，必须是母亲。不过你也许是对的。我不知道。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That’s sort of another reason I’m doing this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这也是我做这件事的另一个原因。{/i}

lines.en: : You mean...you’re looking to act like more of a father figure to her?
lines.zh: : 您是说……您想更像一个父亲那样对她？

lines.en: : {i}That’s the idea.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就是这个意思。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline19
: Well, I think it’s a great one, Sir.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得这是个很棒的想法，先生。

lines.en: : Though, it does further complicate the fact that she wants to harbor your offspring.
lines.zh: : 不过，这确实让她想怀上您孩子这件事变得更复杂了。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: {i}Yeah. That’s a thing I’d really like her to stop wanting as soon as possible.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊。这件事我真希望她能尽快别再想了。{/i}

lines.en: else:
: {i}Yeah. But that’s something I can deal with another day.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊。不过那件事可以改天再说。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyontheline15
: There’s another reason I called, you know.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我打这通电话还有另一个原因。

lines.en: : {i}Aye...And I think I know what it might be if it has anything to do with where this conversation’s currently headed.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是……如果它跟这场对话目前的走向有关，我想我知道是什么了。{/i}

lines.en: : You were essentially just raised by your dad, right?
lines.zh: : 你基本上是你爸一个人带大的，对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Aye, Sir.{/i}
: Then, do you have any tips for me? Things that maybe {i}he{/i} did that I can...try and probably fail at?
lines.zh: : 那么，你有什么建议给我吗？{i}他{/i}做过的、我可以……试着去做、而且大概会做砸的事？

lines.en: : {i}Tips, you say?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}建议，您是说？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah. Anything that may have stuck out to you or...anything you appreciate all these years later.
lines.zh: : 嗯。任何让你印象深刻的事，或者……这么多年后你依然感激的事。

lines.en: : {i}It’s not “all these years later, Sir.” My father is still helping me to this day. How do you think I can afford so many expensive figures and games with my part time cafe salary?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}先生，可不是「这么多年后」。我父亲到今天还在帮我。您以为我靠咖啡馆的兼职工资，怎么买得起那么多昂贵的手办和游戏？{/i}

lines.en: : So the key to parenting is to increase her allowance?
lines.zh: : 所以做父母的关键是给她加零花钱？

lines.en: scene mollyontheline20
: It’s to be mindful of her wants and needs...and to always keep her in your heart and mind.
lines.zh: : 是留意她的想要与需要……并且始终把放在心里、记在脑中。

lines.en: : But an increase in her allowance would work wonders as well, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 不过我相信，给她加零花钱也会有奇效。

lines.en: : {i}Got it. Thanks for your help, Molly.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}明白了。谢谢你的建议，Molly。{/i}

lines.en: : There’s no need to thank me, Sir. I’m just glad you called.
lines.zh: : 您不用谢我，先生。我只是很高兴您打来了。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline21
: I miss you.
lines.zh: : 我想你。

lines.en: : {i}I know...{/i}
: {i}And I’m sorry. For just...kind of vanishing the way I did. But things aren’t exactly easy right now and I just need some time to-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有，对不起。为了我就这么……说消失就消失。可现在事情确实不容易，我只是需要一点时间——{/i}

lines.en: : You don’t owe me an apology, Sir.
lines.zh: : 您不必向我道歉，先生。

lines.en: : {i}I know I don’t owe you one, but I want to give you one. And I also want you to know that it’s not just you I’ve been avoiding. It’s everyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我知道我不欠你一个道歉，但我想给你一个。而且我还想让你知道，我躲的不只是你。是所有人。{/i}

lines.en: : I know, Sir. I can hear the halls, remember?
lines.zh: : 我知道，先生。我听得见走廊的声音，记得吗？

lines.en: scene mollyontheline15
: Right...yeah.
lines.zh: : 对……是的。

lines.en: scene mollyontheline22
: Listen, I-
lines.zh: : 听着，我——

lines.en: : {i}How long will you be camping for, Sir?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您要露营多久，先生？{/i}

lines.en: : Just today I think.
lines.zh: : 我想就今天。

lines.en: : {i}May I see you when you return?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您回来以后，我能见您吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Maybe not right away, but...
lines.zh: : 也许不能马上，不过……

lines.en: : Soon.
lines.zh: : 很快。

lines.en: : {i}I’ll be looking forward to it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我会期待的。{/i}

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : {i}Why do you think?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您觉得为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anyway! I must rail the Kendo Princess now. But I thank you again for the transmission, Sir.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之！我现在必须去干剑道公主了。不过再次感谢您的通讯，先生。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And feel free to reach out again should you need me for anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有什么需要我的地方，随时联系我就好。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
: Sounds good.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。

lines.en: : Thanks, Molly.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Molly。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and slip it back into my pocket, wandering off once more in a direction I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，把它塞回口袋，又一次朝一个我自己也不知道的方向走去。

lines.en: But that’s really what all of this is when you think about it.
lines.zh: 可仔细想想，这一切说到底就是这么回事。

lines.en: Today is just one man’s journey through uncharted territory.
lines.zh: 今天不过是一个男人穿越未知之地的旅程。

lines.en: But it’s nice knowing there will always be an entire class full of girls to lend me an ear when I really need one.
lines.zh: 不过知道有一整班的女孩，随时愿意在我真的需要时借我一只耳朵，感觉还不错。

lines.en: Or, in Molly’s case-
lines.zh: : 或者，在 Molly 这儿——

lines.en: scene apollotheclown
{b}{size=+15}someone who will lend me everything{/size}{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+15}一个愿意借给我一切的人{/size}{/b}

lines.en: scene black
$ mollycamp1 = True
$ molly_love += 1
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}

lines.en: scene sky
Now what should I do?
lines.zh: 现在我该做什么？
